question: Does a per-q_a multi-Delta-t omega-centroid consistency score uniquely single out truth-q_a?
hypothesis: truth-q_a gives consistent omega across Delta (small across-Delta centroid spread); random q_a gives random omega, so consistency ranks truth-q_a high.
narrative_md: Decisive structural failure: the per-q_a across-Delta omega-centroid consistency score ranks truth-q_a LAST (44/44 operational, 43/44 oracle). Top-consistency q_a's sit at ~180deg from truth (twin-region) -- a finite-diff geometric artefact: small-geodesic pairs amplify q_b discretisation noise to large axis perturbations, while large-geodesic pairs are numerically stable. The metric is structurally biased AGAINST truth. Reads truth-q_a ranking -- oracle-leak, N=1.
